name: Cursed Mirror
oracle_text:
{T}: Add {R}.
As this artifact enters, you may have it become a copy of any creature on the battlefield until end of turn, except it has haste.
blocked_sentences: As this artifact enters, you may have it become a copy of any creature on the battlefield until end of turn, except it has haste.

needs.what: an optional 'as this enters, it becomes a copy of <selector>' replacement (706.9 / 614.1c, no stack, no trigger) whose copy effect carries a duration ('until end of turn', after which it reverts to Cursed Mirror) and a copy exception adding a keyword to the copiable values ('except it has haste')
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The packet's `become_copy` op takes `copying`, `duration`, `except_name` and `objects` but has no keyword exception, and it can only run from a `self_enters` trigger, which uses the stack and lets the artifact exist on the battlefield uncopied first (wrong for an 'as enters' replacement and for anything reading what entered). No trigger event or card-level key in `reference` expresses an enters-as-copy replacement; `grant_keyword` haste after the fact is a layer-6 grant, not a copy exception.
